entries.title: Reviewer Cascade State
entries.owner: reviewer transient-failure backoff and route selection
entries.compatibility: Additive cli-resolution-transient failure-class vocabulary in existing breakdown maps; no new durable status. Existing five-consecutive-transient threshold gates pending-upstream; earlier resolution failures release to pending without charging attempts. Existing backoff gates both states. No credential-outage state is written for resolution failure. Pre-model github-budget-deferred uses existing lastFailureModel/lastFailureAt/nextRetryAfter fields without incrementing counters. Its exact-reset hold applies only to the deferred model; existing routing may select another model before reset.
